newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Oppenheimer ups Oakwood Homes.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Oppenheimer ups Oakwood Homes.

text.p: -- Oppenheimer & Co Inc said it raised its rating on Oakwood Homes Corp to buy from outperform and added the stock to its recommended list.
-- Oppenheimer continues to forecast 20 percent earnings per share growth for Oakwood during the next three years. The firm set a $31 a share price target on the stock.
-- Oppenheimer expects Oakwood's stock price to bounce back, along with most of the manufactured homes sector, during the first quarter of 1997.
-- Oppenheimer also initiated coverage on Clayton Homes Inc and added the stock to the recommended list.
-- Analyst David Kerdell set a share price target of $18 for Clayton.

-- Oppenheimer expects Clayton's earnings per share growth to slow to 10 to 15 percent a year during the next three years, but "Clayton's consistency and balance sheet strength warrant a multiple at least in line with the S&P 500."
